original_question: Jordan na-egwu egwuregwu vidiyo awa abụọ kwa ụbọchị. Ọ nwekwara ọrụ nchere oge ebe ọ na-enweta $10 n'otu awa. Ego ole ka Jordan ga-enweta n'otu izu ụka ma o were oge egwuregwu vidiyo na-arụ ọrụ?
question_template: {name_male, Jordan} na-egwu egwuregwu vidiyo awa {num_digit_1, 2} kwa ụbọchị. Ọ nwekwara ọrụ nchere oge ebe ọ na-enweta ${num_digit_2, 10} n'otu awa. Ego ole ka {name_male, Jordan} ga-enweta n' {num_text_1, otu}  izu ụka ma o were oge egwuregwu vidiyo na-arụ ọrụ?
